Flag CTAS scores with a gsm-shaped Flag column

Flag_CTAS.Rd

User-facing gsm-style flagging function that mirrors the gsm.core::Flag() signature but with unsigned CTAS defaults appropriate for the -log10(p) scoring scale. Adds a Flag column to dfAnalyzed based on left-closed intervals of the score column.

Usage

Flag_CTAS(
  dfAnalyzed,
  strColumn = "Score",
  vThreshold = c(0.842, 2.326),
  vFlag = c(0, 1, 2),
  vFlagOrder = c(2, 1, 0),
  nAccrualThreshold = NULL,
  strAccrualMetric = NULL
)

Arguments

dfAnalyzed

data.frame Aggregated CTAS scores, typically the output of Summarize_CTAS(). Must contain strColumn.

strColumn

character Column to threshold. Default "Score".

vThreshold

numeric Ascending threshold values. Default c(0.842, 2.326).

vFlag

numeric Flag values, one longer than vThreshold. Default c(0, 1, 2).

vFlagOrder

numeric Sort order for the returned rows. Must contain the same values as vFlag. Default c(2, 1, 0) (red first). Pass NULL to leave rows unsorted.

nAccrualThreshold

numeric Minimum accrual value below which Score and Flag are set to NA. Default NULL (no accrual filter).

strAccrualMetric

character Column to compare against nAccrualThreshold. One of "Numerator", "Denominator", "Difference" (Denominator - Numerator). Required when nAccrualThreshold is set.

Value

data.frame dfAnalyzed with an added Flag column, optionally sorted by vFlagOrder.

Details

CTAS -log10(p) is one-sided and non-negative, so the defaults are two ascending thresholds (0.842, 2.326 – 80% and 99% one-sided normal z-quantiles) with three flag levels (0 = green, 1 = amber, 2 = red). A Flag = 2 means the site differs from its peers; the unsigned scale carries no directional information.

See also

gsm.core::Flag() for the signed gsm-core variant.

Examples

dfSummary <- data.frame(
  MetricID = "ctas_AST",
  GroupID = c("101", "102", "103"),
  Score = c(0.1, 1.2, 3.0),
  Numerator = c(2, 4, 3),
  Denominator = c(2, 4, 3)
)
Flag_CTAS(dfSummary)
#>   MetricID GroupID Score Numerator Denominator Flag
#> 1 ctas_AST     103   3.0         3           3    2
#> 2 ctas_AST     102   1.2         4           4    1
#> 3 ctas_AST     101   0.1         2           2    0
